parsed.summary: Potential OOM on startup due to reading entire job log file into memory; recent() reads whole file regardless of requested tail size, and on_boot() calls recent(5000) which can be huge. No other critical bugs found.

findings.issue: Function recent() reads the entire LOG_FILE into memory before slicing the last N lines. on_boot() invokes recent(5000) on every startup, which can cause excessive memory usage if the log file has grown large before the trimming step.
findings.suggestion: Implement a true tail read that only loads the last N lines (e.g., using a reverse file iterator or reading in chunks). Also consider limiting the size of recent() calls or using a rotating log to keep the file bounded.
